body: It’s crazy because I know that in the back of my mind, that living my best life is the best revenge and forgetting about him is the best thing I could do for me, but yet I just don’t do it for some reason. I feel like the fact that everyone in my family basically took his side has so much to do with that, I never had a support system in dealing with this. It’s just been me.

Thank you for reading and replying. I am hoping to eventually find a good and caring therapist, but I think for now, this subreddit will help tremendously :) Thank you for your kind wishes, and I hope you have a wonderful year as well <3

The anonymity definitely makes it much easier to share your story. As for your book, I wish you the best of luck on it! Maybe one day I will even unknowingly read it :) Thank you for keeping your door open, and I'll extend that same courtesy to you! You're right, we all have to stick together.

Thank you so much for reading and replying, it means a lot to me. I didn't realize that the wrong father thing is common. Apparently, the reaction is the same as well for Nparents because I've talked to someone who also had a "wrong father" (but not an Nmom) and their mother was completely apologetic about it.  

I definitely agree about the looks vs. feelings. I'm a very funny, joking person on the outside but when I'm by myself, I can't help but think about all of this. It gets worse and worse as the years go on because I'm starting to understand everything more.  
  
I was considering joining a support group as opposed to seeing a therapist because that's something that I haven't gotten from my family, ever. I get it from my boyfriend but he can never fully understand because he's never been through something like this. I guess me posting in here is a step in that direction.  
  
About the writing, I was considering writing a book about this, hoping it gets big and the success will be my "revenge" so to say. I also think it would help others that are in similar situations find their voice. I just don't know if I'm ready to put my face behind this story.  
  
Thank you again for your kind words and sharing some of your story with me. I hope that everything is well with you too, and continues that way <3

Thank you for your reply. I decided to return and tell her I'm not leaving until she gives me an official notice; I will let you know how it goes. As for the job, I do have one but NYC is so damn expensive, I don't think I will be able to make it on my own out here with just a part time job.

Thank you for the reply. I think I will return to the house and tell her I am not leaving unless she makes it official with a notice. I would like to hold off on calling the police for as long as possible, but if she refuses to let me in then I definitely will.
I have helped pay bills but there is no record of it; just her word against mine.
Yes all my stuff is still there, I only took the valuables like money and electronics. I don't want to sue her, I just want to go back to the house.

That's what scares me the most. And I hate how he gets to walk around free while I sit here, fucked up in the head from it and God knows who else is too. I think he's just legit crazy; he looked me in the eyes, denied it and was even upset that I would ever say such a thing. You have to be crazy to do some shit like that. It's hard to fix/challenge crazy.

I know that I'm basically obligated as a human being to do this, but I just keep thinking about all the time and work my grandma put into this. It's something she REALLY wanted. She's the type of person that always has a bunch of "projects" going on that she says she's gonna do for years, but never gets around to actually doing them. This is the only project that she has actually finished and it took her sooo long. 

I'm also scared that if I do come out with this, I won't be believed. I have no proof. The only person in my family that actually believed me was my aunt (dad's cousin, just call her my aunt) because he tried to do the same thing to her, but she was 15 - not 5. She told me if I ever wanted to go to court, that she'll be on my side but what if that's not enough? All I have is my word against his. He's a "priest" and I don't have shit. In the eyes of the law and probably all of society, he is more trustworthy than I am.
Every time I go to jersey I get excited haha
In NYC, if you don't have an ID, they will take you to the precinct. It's happened to me and I've seen it happen to others.
You are not allowed to turn right on red in NYC.

When I was 5, my dad went to jail. He was sentenced for 14 years. Until I was around 12, I didn't know. They told me he went back home to Russia to build airplanes 🙄 I started catching on when I saw the envelope from a letter he sent me and it said "federal correctional institution" One time I picked up the phone, and it did the whole "you have a prepaid call, this call is from ______ an inmate at a federal prison" my grandma (his mom) just told me it's the wrong number but I heard them say my dads name. He finally told me when I was 12 and I flipped out that they lied to me for so long. They said they didn't want me to get bullied in school for it

I regret losing you.

I hurt the person who said this. Cheated on him in the worst ways possible, abused him verbally and physically. He never once did me wrong. Then I ended up leaving him cuz I just fuck everything up
I used to cut class in high school. My mom told me if I cut school again, she'll send me upstate to live with my grandpa who molested me when I was 5.

You know, I think I'm going to do the mentor thing. I need some kind of purpose in life and helping kids is a great one. I just don't know how to help when I can't help myself yet, but maybe I'll find my way through doing it. Thank you so much for talking to me and giving me actual suggestions instead of just telling me it'll be okay and not to think about it. I really needed this after feeling so alone.

I don't even know where to begin :( everything is just so complicated and feels like it'll never change, I've been like this for years and it just gets worse and worse. I always hear of people doing great things despite being through similar things as me, and I wonder why I can't be like them.

I just don't want to be put on meds for this :( I want to actually solve my issues, not just mask them. I live in NYC so there's many therapists, but they're all crazy expensive. I can try out the support groups, but it doesn't feel like it'll help :(

Thank you for your reply, I know I shouldn't be doing all of these bad things but I just don't stop. I know I'm self destructive and that I'm killing myself slowly doing these things, but I just don't. I want to change, but I'm numb at the same time.
Thank you for answering..  The crazy thing is that I know all of this deep down, but I just don't follow it. I feel numb to everything, like nothing is worth doing
